label: Thesis predicate contained in spacetime: ContainedInSpacetime F P:= ∀ x, P x → PartOfSpacetime F…
definition: `ContainedInSpacetime F P := ∀ x, P x → PartOfSpacetime F x`: whatever satisfies the naturalist's thesis predicate is a part of the spacetime whole.
note: Stipulative bridge. True by definition for P = PartOfSpacetime F; open for the occupant and relational senses; and doubtful for Papineau's 'physical', which he glosses as non-mental (DEF-PAPINEAU-PHYSICAL), so that a non-mental thing outside spacetime would count as physical.
